frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Candidate residue: "cognition — the mind's grasp/hold of a determinate fact, and by extension the determinate-thing-that-is-known and the act of causing it to be known." After subtracting form, this residue is directly visible in the overwhelming mass of occurrences: Form I/V verbs ʿalima/yaʿlamu/taʿallama = "to know / come to know / learn" (100:9 "does he not know", 102:3-5 "you will come to know", 2:102 "they learn"); the ADJ/intensive ʿalīm / aʿlam = "All-Knowing / more-knowing" (the property of knowing, ~150 occ); the abstract noun ʿilm / al-ʿilm = "knowledge, the known content" (102:5 ʿilm al-yaqīn, ~110 occ); Form II ʿallama + muʿallam = "to teach / one taught" (2:31 "He taught Adam", 44:14 "a taught madman", 42 occ — Form II supplies causation, the residue supplies the knowing that is caused); and the passive participle maʿlūm = "known / appointed / determinate" (yawm/maqām/ajal/ḥaqq maʿlūm — 15:38, 37:164, 70:24 — the thing fixed BECAUSE known/specified, ~11 occ). Across these ~776 occurrences the cognition residue is non-empty, distinctive, and demonstrably present in every verse cited.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Candidate residue: "cognition — the mind's grasp/hold of a determinate fact, and by extension the determinate-thing-that-is-known and the act of causing it to be known." After subtracting form, this residue is directly visible in the overwhelming mass of occurrences: Form I/V verbs ʿalima/yaʿlamu/taʿallama = "to know / come to know / learn" (100:9 "does he not know", 102:3-5 "you will come to know", 2:102 "they learn"); the ADJ/intensive ʿalīm / aʿlam = "All-Knowing / more-knowing" (the property of knowing, ~150 occ); the abstract noun ʿilm / al-ʿilm = "knowledge, the known content" (102:5 ʿilm al-yaqīn, ~110 occ); Form II ʿallama + muʿallam = "to teach / one taught" (2:31 "He taught Adam", 44:14 "a taught madman", 42 occ — Form II supplies causation, the residue supplies the knowing that is caused); and the passive participle maʿlūm = "known / appointed / determinate" (yawm/maqām/ajal/ḥaqq maʿlūm — 15:38, 37:164, 70:24 — the thing fixed BECAUSE known/specified, ~11 occ). Across these ~776 occurrences the cognition residue is non-empty, distinctive, and demonstrably present in every verse cited.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ع ل م is the Qur'an's "knowing" root and it saturates ~776 of its 854 occurrences with one stable core: to hold a fact in the mind (know), the one who does so (the Knower / All-Knowing), the content held (knowledge), the causing of another to hold it (teach), and the thing that is fixed because it is known (appointed/determinate). That core is clean and universal across the whole cognition family. BUT the packet also assigns to this same root two occurrence-islands that do NOT display the knowing residue on the verse evidence alone: (1) al-ʿālamīn "the worlds / all creatures / all peoples" — 76 occurrences, the fixed phrase rabb al-ʿālamīn "Lord of the worlds" (1:2, 21:107, 26:16...) and "preferred over the worlds" (2:47) — where the text shows only "created realms / nations," with no cognition content; and (2) kal-aʿlām "like the mountains/landmarks," describing ships in the sea (42:32, 55:24) — where the sense is a prominent physical marker, not a mental act. Reconciling these to "knowing" requires the classical etymology (ʿālam = "that by which the Maker is known"; ʿalam = "a mark by which a thing is recognized"), which is lexicon/tafsir — barred as evidence here. From the occurrences alone, these 78 do not carry the residue, so a single distinctive contribution present in EVERY occurrence cannot be established without forcing.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Form was subtracted throughout: Form I = bare cognition (know); Form II (V(II), 41) and N(II) muʿallam contribute CAUSATION (make-to-know = teach), not extra root meaning; Form V (taʿallama, 2) contributes reflexive/acquisitive voice (know-for-oneself = learn); the ADJ intensive pattern (ʿalīm/aʿlam) contributes the attributive/elative grade, not the residue. Construction was subtracted: maʿlūm is passive-participle "that-which-is-known," the "appointed/fixed" reading is a construction+context effect (idafa with yawm/ajal/rizq), the residue underneath is still "known." Participants/context (who knows, what is known) were held out. What remains after all subtraction in the 776-set is the bare cognition residue. The two resistant islands (al-ʿālamīn "worlds"; kal-aʿlām "landmarks") are NOT reachable by any form/construction subtraction from "know" — they are lexically distinct nominal stems that the morphology bundles under the same tri-consonantal root.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: al-ʿālamīn "the worlds" (76 occ), archetype rabb al-ʿālamīn "Lord of the worlds" (1:2), and "I preferred you over the worlds" (2:47), plus kal-aʿlām "like the mountains/landmarks" for ships at sea (42:32, 55:24). In none of these does the verse text exhibit any act, faculty, or content of knowing. "Worlds/all-creatures/nations" is a cosmological/collective sense; "landmark-mountains" is a physical-marker sense. The cognition residue is simply not present on the evidence; it can only be inserted by importing the disallowed etymology that ʿālam/ʿalam derive from "a sign by which something is known." Per the hard rule, one irreconcilable occurrence defeats universal presence — here there are 78.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Competing (broader) hypothesis: the true residue is not "cognition" but "a determinate distinguishing mark by which a thing is set apart and thereby known" — which would fold in ʿalam/aʿlām (landmark), maʿlūm (marked-out/fixed), and possibly ʿālamīn (the distinct/marked orders of being). This is rejected on two counts: (a) it STILL cannot be shown in al-ʿālamīn from verse evidence — "Lord of the worlds" gives no mark/knowing content — so it does not rescue universal presence; and (b) broadening "know" to "mark/sign/distinction" collapses distinctiveness, making the residue indistinguishable from roots like ʾ-y-h (āya, sign) and w-s-m (wasm, mark). The narrower "cognition" residue is better supported for the 776-set precisely because it stays distinctive; but neither the narrow nor the broad reading achieves genuine universal presence.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: For the 776 cognition-set the residue is sharply distinctive: it is mental grasp/hold-of-a-fact, separable from perception roots (s-m-ʿ hear, b-ṣ-r see: 6:50, 17:47 pair aʿlam WITH samīʿ/baṣīr, showing knowing is treated as a distinct faculty), from ẓ-n-n (surmise/conjecture, the explicit contrastive antonym), from ḥ-k-m (judge/wisdom), and from dh-k-r (recall). The falsifier: any cognition occurrence where ʿalima means mere sensory perception or mere opinion without settled factual grasp — none found in the 776-set. However, distinctiveness cuts the other way for the resistant islands: because the cognition residue is this sharp, it visibly does NOT extend to "worlds" or "landmark-mountains," which belong to different semantic fields (cosmos/collectivity; topographic marker).

internal_discovery.rationale: Universal presence does NOT hold. A single, distinctive, non-empty cognition residue ("mind's grasp of a determinate fact," with its causative 'teach', acquisitive 'learn', attributive 'All-Knowing', abstract 'knowledge', and passive 'known/appointed' extensions) is STRONGLY and demonstrably present in ~776/854 occurrences after subtracting Form I/II/V, participle construction, and context — this sub-result is robust. But the packet's own morphology bundles under root ع ل م two occurrence-islands — al-ʿālamīn "the worlds" (76) and kal-aʿlām "landmark-mountains" (2) — in which the verse text shows no knowing residue whatsoever. Reconciling them requires importing lexical etymology (ʿālam/ʿalam as "sign by which a thing is known"), which the hard rules forbid as evidence, and even the broadened "distinguishing-mark" residue (a) still cannot be exhibited in "Lord of the worlds" from the text and (b) sacrifices distinctiveness against āya/wasm. With 78 confirmed occurrences irreconcilable on occurrence-internal evidence, the non-negotiable unity rule forbids declaring presence; forcing a percentage-majority is explicitly disallowed. Honest verdict: the cognition residue is a strong PARTIAL contribution over the knowledge macro-cluster, but universal presence across all 854 is UNRESOLVED, gated by the ʿālamīn "worlds" cluster (and secondarily the aʿlām "landmarks" pair).

adversarial_verification.notes:
REFUTED. The packet is full-coverage with 854 confirmed occurrences, but the proposed "cognition" residue only accounts for ~776 of them — the proponent's own count silently drops ~78. Extracting the exact ʿ-l-m token per occurrence (via word_ref word-index against the verse) exposes what was dropped: a coherent non-cognition block that QAC assigns to root ع ل م but where the residue "the mind's grasp/hold of a determinate fact / the thing-known / causing-to-be-known" is NOT demonstrably present after subtracting form/construction/context.

FAILING CLUSTER A — al-ʿālamīn "the worlds / all created beings / mankind" (75 occ, form N): ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ / لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ / عَٰلَمِينَ. E.g. 1:2 "rabb al-ʿālamīn" (Lord of the worlds), 21:107 "raḥmatan lil-ʿālamīn" (a mercy to the worlds), 3:42 "ʿalā nisāʾi l-ʿālamīn" (over the women of the worlds), 45:16, 32:2, 26:*, 37:*, etc. The referent is the created order / all beings — a plurality of WORLDS, not an act of knowing, not a known content, not a causing-to-know. Reading a cognition sense in requires the etymological gloss "ʿālam = that by which the Creator is known/a sign," which is lexicon/etymology reasoning explicitly barred as evidence and is NOT visible in the occurrence itself.

FAILING CLUSTER B — aʿlām "mountains / towering landmarks" (2 occ, form N): 42:32 and 55:24 "al-jawāri fī l-baḥri ka-l-aʿlām" (the ships in the sea like mountains/landmarks). Sense = landmark/mountain (from ʿalam "mark/sign"), not cognition; residue absent.

Total unreconciled confirmed occurrences: 77 (75 + 2), all form N, no intra-verse duplicates. 854 − 77 = 777, matching the ~776 the proponent enumerated — i.e. the residue is universally present ONLY on the pre-selected cognition subset, which is circular.

Borderline (NOT counted as failing): 43:61 "wa-innahu la-ʿilmun lil-sāʿah" (form N, ʿilm) is reconcilable as "knowledge/portent of the Hour" and stays within the residue.

Distinctiveness: where the cognition residue DOES apply (the verb/adj/ʿilm/Form II/maʿlūm mass) it is genuinely distinctive vs nearest knowing-roots (ع-ر-ف recognize, ش-ع-ر perceive, د-ر-ي, ف-ق-ه, ح-ك-م), so distinctiveness_ok holds for that subset. Falsifiability: the claim is falsifiable and was in fact falsified by cluster A/B. But root semantic unity is non-negotiable: with 77 confirmed occurrences unreconciled under a single "cognition" contribution, universal presence does not hold. Verdict != SUPPORTED → REFUTED.

وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ — intensive adjective 'All-Knowing'; the property of holding facts in the mind is asserted, in explicit contrast within the same verse to the bedouins who do not know (أَلَّا يَعْلَمُوا۟) the limits.

أَلَّا يَعْلَمُوا۟ حُدُودَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ — Form I verb 'that they not know the limits of what Allah revealed'; the grasp/hold of a determinate fact (the revealed limits) is the direct object of the negated verb — the residue is present under negation.

وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ — 'Hearing, Knowing' closing a verse about hidden motives (taking spending as a loss, awaiting reversals); the knowing of these concealed states is exactly the cognition residue.
